name: Tight 707 funk pocket
desc: Machine-tight JB pocket on a 707: kick on the one and the and-of-two, cracking snare on 2&4 with fixed-gain ghost 16ths around it, 16th hats with accent rotation and an open hat sting on the and-of-four. Everything breathes wider at peak.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

code.sparse: stack(s("[bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}).shape(.2), s("[~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.55).room(.2), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.35 .15]*4").mask("<1 1 1 0>")).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("[bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("[~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.6).room(.22), s("[~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd sd ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${ghost}).pan(.45), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.42 .16 .28 .16]*4").pan(cosine.range(.42,.58).slow(9)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[~ ~ ~ oh]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.42).lpf(6000).pan(.6)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("[~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.64).room(.22), s("[~ sd sd ~ ~ ~ sd sd ~ sd ~ sd ~ ~ sd ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${ghost}*1.2).pan(.44), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.48 .2 .32 .2]*4").pan(cosine.range(.38,.62).slow(7)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[~ ~ ~ oh]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.5).lpf(7000).pan(.62), s("rim(5,16,2)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.22).pan(.35)).orbit(1).play()
